en: “Sorry... is tomorrow okay...?”
“I'm not really in the mood...”
“I don't feel well... How about next time?”
“No way! We have to use a condom!”
“Hm? Now? Sure... let's do it.”
“Mkay... Let's enjoy ourselves a little—”
“Mmm... Don't worry.... I want it too...”
“You can do whatever you want... I'm all yours...”
“Hehe... How about we start with cuddling?”
“Idiot... I've been waiting for a long time...”
“Come on... Let me feel it again...”
“No... Don't make me wait any longer—!”
“Are you making this request because you know what day today is?”
“Kasumi...”
“Hehe. I already know what you're thinking!”
“I guess you saw the notebook on the table.”
“Sorry... for reading it.”
“Why do you think I wrote it down?”
“And put it in such an obvious place—”
“Maybe I wanted you to find out~♡”
“I think... I can't hold it much longer...”
“I can see that. It's been hard since we started talking.”
“So... if you want... you can put it in me today~♡”
